about: Dawson Creek is a city in northeastern British Columbia’s Peace River Country, famous as Mile 0 of the Alaska Highway. Grain elevators, prairie-meets-boreal farmland, and a role as a highway and energy-service hub define the community near the Alberta border. About 13,000 people live in Dawson Creek.
